job.title: Recruitment Consultant
job.description:
Recruitment Consultant / Senior Recruitment Consultant

Technology Recruitment

Cardiff HQ | Hybrid (3 Days in Office) | £30,000 - £50,000 + Uncapped Commission

The Technology team at Yolk is growing, and we're looking for ambitious recruiters who want to build a market, develop meaningful client relationships and earn well while doing it

We recruit across some of the most in-demand technology markets in the UK and Europe, including Data, AI, Software Engineering, Cloud, Infrastructure, Cyber Security and Technology Leadership.

Whether you're already an experienced technology recruiter, recruit in another sector, or have a strong sales background and want to move into recruitment, we're interested in speaking with you.

This is an opportunity to join an established and successful team with access to existing clients, proven delivery processes, modern recruitment technology, marketing support and experienced leadership. You'll have the freedom to develop your own specialism and build a desk that genuinely feels like your own.

What you'll be doing:

  • Running a full 360 recruitment desk from business development through to placement
  • Developing your own specialist market within technology
  • Winning new business and growing existing client relationships
  • Building long-term relationships with hiring managers and candidates
  • Advising clients on market conditions, salary trends and hiring strategies
  • Managing recruitment processes from initial brief through to offer and placement
  • Negotiating commercial terms, salaries and contract rates
  • Contributing to a collaborative and supportive team environment

What we're looking for:

  • Recruitment experience, or a strong background in sales, business development or account management
  • A genuine appetite for relationship building and business development
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of what drives results
  • Confidence picking up the phone and having conversations others avoid
  • Ambition to build and take ownership of your own market
  • Self-motivation and the ability to work independently
  • A positive attitude and willingness to learn

Technology recruitment experience is helpful, but not essential. We're more interested in attitude, drive and the ability to build relationships.

What you'll get:

  • Uncapped commission from day one
  • A genuine opportunity to build and own your market
  • Access to established clients, technology, marketing support and leadership backing
  • Clear progression opportunities as you grow
  • Hybrid working
  • Flexible start times
  • Private medical healthcare
  • Birthday day off
  • Extended Christmas shutdown
  • Quarterly incentives and team socials
  • Employee referral bonuses of up to £1,500
  • Additional wellbeing and benefits package

Why Yolk?

We're ambitious, but we're not interested in KPI theatre. We care about standards and results, but we trust people to run their desks like professionals. You'll get support when you need it and the opportunity to build something meaningful rather than simply maintain somebody else's client base.

If you're looking for a business where you can make an impact, increase your earnings and help shape the future of a growing technology division, we'd love to have a conversation.

For a confidential discussion, contact Lewis Allen or apply with your CV.

job.title: Recruitment Consultant
job.description:
Recruitment Consultant
Cardiff/Hybrid + flexible hours
Leading salary and commission + extensive benefits

Yolk Engineering & Technical is the largest division within Yolk Recruitment, working with manufacturing and engineering employers across the UK and Ireland.

We recruit across established and emerging technical markets, partnering with businesses ranging from growing SMEs and scale-ups through to major international employers.

We’re looking for experienced 360 Recruitment Consultants who want to develop a specialist market, build strong client relationships and increase both their earnings and their career opportunities.

There is a strong track record within the division of Consultants achieving promotions, salary increases and career-best commissions. For those who want to progress into leadership, there is also a clear route into management and beyond.

You’ll have the freedom to build your market, backed by experienced leaders and colleagues, the latest recruitment technology, ongoing training and a business that rewards high performance properly.

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing your own specialist market within engineering, manufacturing or technical recruitment
  • Winning new business and developing existing client relationships
  • Building a strong understanding of your clients, their businesses and their recruitment challenges
  • Advising clients on recruitment strategy, market conditions, salaries and candidate availability
  • Identifying, attracting and developing relationships with specialist candidates
  • Managing recruitment processes from initial brief through to interview, offer and placement
  • Negotiating salaries, rates and commercial terms
  • Building long-term relationships with clients and candidates rather than focusing purely on individual vacancies
  • Working closely with the wider Engineering & Technical team to share knowledge, opportunities and relationships

What we’re looking for

  • Successful experience in the recruitment industry
  • A genuine appetite for 360 recruitment and business development
  • The ambition to build and take ownership of your own market
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills
  • Commercial awareness and confidence speaking with clients
  • Resilience and the ability to stay focused when things do not go to plan
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to work closely with the wider team
  • An interest in becoming genuinely knowledgeable within your recruitment specialism
  • Confidence using technology and new recruitment tools

Above all, we’re looking for people with integrity, ambition and a desire to keep improving.

What you’ll get in return

  • Leading salary, level depending on experience
  • Uncapped commission
  • Clear promotion and career development pathways
  • Training and development tailored to your level of experience
  • Hybrid working
  • Flexible start times between 7.30am – 9am
  • Free on-site parking
  • Additional holidays – your birthday, Christmas shutdown on top of your allowance, and a day to support any charity
  • £1,000 a year in discounts and savings towards everyday expenditure
  • Employee referral bonuses of up to £1,500
  • Charity days to support our CSR initiatives
  • Regular social events, quarterly activities and an all-expenses-paid AGM afterparty
  • Private medical healthcare, including on-demand GP services and optical and dental cover
  • Access to professional financial advice

If you’re an experienced recruiter looking for a bigger opportunity to develop your market, earnings and career, apply here or contact Managing Director Phil for a confidential conversation.
